headline: Meridian Electronics wins quality award from industry association
body: Meridian Electronics received a supplier excellence award citing low defect rates and strong on-time delivery. The company plans to publish its audit results later this year.

headline: Regulators open inquiry into Meridian Electronics labeling practices
body: A regulator opened an inquiry into product labeling at Meridian Electronics. The company said it is cooperating and that no violations have been established.

headline: Meridian Electronics announces layoffs affecting 15% of workforce
body: Meridian Electronics said it will cut 15% of its workforce as part of a cost reduction program. Unions criticized the lack of consultation.

headline: Meridian Electronics publishes annual sustainability report
body: Meridian Electronics released its annual sustainability report covering energy use and waste reduction targets. The report was prepared in line with standard reporting guidelines.

headline: Meridian Electronics signs multi-year framework agreement
body: Meridian Electronics announced a framework agreement with a large manufacturer. Terms were not disclosed, and the company expects stable volumes through the contract period.
